knobs.name: The hitches first
knobs.now: On your Nov 24 night our own code cost 0.6 ms a frame on average - small - but a few frames took 40-85 ms (Classes, Gun, Director, Shops): a stutter you can feel.
opts: Find and fix the hitches before anything else
knobs.why: A steady 80 fps with a stutter every minute feels worse than 70 without one.

knobs.name: The dead alive at once
knobs.now: 64 (and up to half again for a moment in a big wave).
knobs.why: You peaked at 29 bodies near you on Nov 24: the cap isn't what costs.

knobs.name: The dead thinking at full speed
knobs.now: 24 near you, 6 more per player in co-op; the rest move simply.
knobs.why: Skyrim's AI is its biggest cost; 24 keeps a crowd alive without the frame rate falling.

knobs.name: Bodies left on the ground
knobs.now: 18, the oldest crumbling as new ones fall.
knobs.why: Bodies cost physics; with ash, shatter and melt deaths (The dead tab) far fewer are left anyway.

knobs.name: Our effects at once
knobs.now: 32 bursts at a time; any more wait.
knobs.why: Enough for every heavy in a crowd; more and the glow piles up into white.

knobs.name: Effects on a big night
knobs.now: Every effect at full detail, however many are going.
opts: Fewer particles past 30 of the dead near you
knobs.why: You won't see the difference in a crowd; your frame rate will.

knobs.name: Light cast by effects
knobs.now: Each effect lights the ground and the dead (Skyrim's own light on its effects).
opts: Only the big ones (heavies, spells) on a big night
knobs.why: Skyrim draws only a few lights at once; dozens of small ones flicker in and out.

knobs.name: The horde's sounds
knobs.now: A budget of the dead's sounds at once; your own sounds never wait.
opts: Fewer of the dead's groans in a crowd
knobs.why: It already works: your hits are always heard.
